kind: official beds (katil rasmi); the same page also describes the 1,261 as beds in operation (katil operasi)
note: Hospital home page, section 'Statistik Tahunan HTAR', citing the hospital's Medical Records Department statistics for 2025. The sentence says 'katil operasi'; the counter tile beside it is labelled 'Jumlah katil rasmi 2025' and holds 1261 as text in the page HTML (data-digit attribute, not an image). No disagreement: the Selangor State Assembly written answer of Feb-Mar 2025 lists 1261 official and 1261 operating beds (https://dewan.selangor.gov.my/question/fasiliti-kesihatan-di-selangor/). An earlier State Assembly answer (Nov 2024) listed 1253 operating beds. The hospital's 'Mengenai Kami' page only says 'lebih 1000 katil'.

kind: official beds (katil rasmi); only 146 beds in operation (katil operasi)
note: CAUTION, sources disagree widely. Quote is a table row; columns are Bilangan Katil Rasmi (288), Bilangan Katil Operasi (146), BOR 2024 % (105.5). Chosen because it is the most recent official per-hospital figure: Selangor State Legislative Assembly written answer (sitting 18 Feb-3 Mar 2025) carrying JKN Selangor / KKM data, classed here as 'ministry' tier; year is the date of the answer. For usable capacity the realistic figure is 146, not 288. Other figures: 144 operating beds (State Assembly answer, Nov 2024); 270 official beds (JKN Selangor list 'Tahun 2023', Wayback copy, see Serdang note); 150 beds (Health Minister at the handover, Bernama via NST, 26 Sep 2022, news tier). The hospital's own 'Latar Belakang' page (https://jknselangor.moh.gov.my/htgkarang/index.php/profil-hospital/sejarah) still says 114 beds, which describes the old 1966 building that was replaced by the new hospital at Sungai Terap in Oct 2022, so it was not used.
